name: Banana-Free Pudding Parfait (Fudge or Butterscotch)
whyItWorks: Smooth calories that require zero mechanical chewing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer chocolate fudge, vanilla, or butterscotch pudding cups with lactose-free whipped cream and crushed graham crackers or Nilla wafers (let sit 5 mins to soften into cake texture).
